Most of the minable coal on the leases is contained in two beds as shown in Figure II-3.
GEOLOGIC CROSS SECTION

OF LOWER STRATA IN FORT UNION FORMATION
Numerous thin coal beds occur in units older than the Tongue River member of the Fort Union formation, notably in the Lebo and Tullock Creek members, but because of their poor quality and thinness, these coals are not currently considered economically feasible for large-scale extraction in the Project Area.
